QuestInfo.name: Romero and Tonero
QuestInfo.0: You took care of both #p3001005#'s and #p3001004#'s requests. Maybe you can get some dirt on them from #b#p3001006##k.
QuestInfo.1: Find out more about #b#p3001005##k and #b#p3001004##k from #b#p3001006##k.
QuestInfo.2: Friends, huh... Maybe you and #p3000007# can go back to being friends one day.

0.1: You want to know more about #p3001004# and #p3001005# now, don't you?
0.2: I don't know that I should be blabbing. It's kind of a secret...

yes.0: Okay, I'll tell ya all about it. It's not a secret to the merchant crew, after all. Hey, if I get you a robe and a mask, you'll be one of us!
yes.1: Anyways, take care of whatever it was you were doing. I'll tell you when you come back!

no.0: Well, I can't tell you if you can't keep a secret!

1.0: #p3001004# and #p3001005# are the same age. They've been friends since forever and learned the ways of merchants as they grew up.
1.1: Honestly, #p3001005# is a fantastic trader because of his strong-arm tactics. The thing is, #p3001004# always brings in better results.
1.2: So...it's pretty obvious, right? #p3001005# is jealous of #p3001004#. And I feel that #p3001004# is the one who is handling this precarious relationship ever so wisely.
1.3: By now, I'm sure you realized that they have different style of making profit. They are both well-acknowledged in the merchant crew, but they aren't going back to their friendly selves.
1.4: I can shed a little light on our trading stats. #p3001005#'s items are hot right now, while #p3001004#'s stores are causing quite a stir. Hard to say how it'll all pan out.

yes.0: I've told you everything I know. Time to finish up your business with #p3001005# and #p3001004#.
yes.1: #b#p3001005##k was looking pretty antsy last I saw him. Maybe you'd better get over there right away.
